column1: What is one way businesses use social media to promote products?
column2: By posting adverts, product photos, videos, and updates to attract attention and encourage sales.

column1: How does social media help businesses communicate directly with customers?
column2: Customers can comment, like, message, share posts, and respond quickly to business content.

column1: Why is social media often cheaper for businesses than traditional advertising?
column2: It can reach large audiences online without the high production and placement costs of TV, radio, or print campaigns.

column1: How can businesses use social media to build brand awareness?
column2: By posting regular content, using recognisable branding, and sharing messages that keep the business visible to audiences.

column1: Why is user-generated content valuable to businesses on social media?
column2: It encourages engagement and can act as promotion when customers share photos, reviews, or posts about the brand.

column1: How can businesses use social media for market research?
column2: They can read comments, reactions, shares, and messages to find out what customers like or dislike.

column1: What is one limitation of using social media for business promotion?
column2: Posts can be ignored easily, and negative comments or reviews can also spread quickly.

column1: Social media platforms, digital games, and _____ are all media products.
column2: comic books

column1: What are two primary functions of social media for businesses?
column2: To connect with customers and to promote their products.

column1: Name three social media platforms that businesses commonly use.
column2: Any three from: Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok.

column1: Give two ways businesses use social media.
column2: To promote products or services and to communicate with customers.

column1: A general explanation of social media use without detailed analysis lacks what?
column2: Detailed analysis.

column1: A strong explanation of how businesses use social media should include examples and some _____.
column2: analysis

column1: Give two business uses of social media.
column2: Promotion/advertising and customer communication/engagement.

column1: Businesses use social media as part of the wider digital _____.
column2: marketing strategy

column1: What kind of content can users post on social media platforms?
column2: Text, photos, videos, links, comments, and live content.

column1: The reading materials list 'photos' and 'text' as examples of what type of content?
column2: User-generated content.

column1: What is the usual funding model for social media platforms?
column2: They are usually funded by advertising.

column1: Social media platforms make heavy use of media like photos and _____ to lay out text and images.
column2: graphics

column1: Term: App.
column2: Definition: Software installed onto smartphones, tablets, and smart televisions.

column1: Name three types of devices that can have apps installed.
column2: Smartphones, tablets, and computers.

column1: Besides games and shopping, name two other categories of apps mentioned in the reading materials.
column2: Any two from: navigation, office and work, email, social media.
